items.title: Bendigo Writers Festival in 'unreserved' apology to author Abdel-Fattah
items.summary: Festival organiser Greater Bendigo City Council says it sincerely regrets infringing Palestinian Australian academic Dr Randa Abdel-Fattah's intellectual and artistic freedom.

items.title: Israeli air strike on Doctors Without Borders Gaza office kills two
items.summary: The World Health Organization condemns attacks on health facilities after an Israeli air strike on an MSF building in Gaza killed two people.

items.title: Snails cause harvest headache for South Australian farmers
items.summary: An increase in snail numbers is causing issues for some farmers in the middle of what is expected to be a record-breaking harvest.

items.title: North Melbourne AFLW duo announce retirement after historic three-peat
items.summary: Inaugural AFLW Kangaroos captain and eight-time All Australian Emma Kearney has announced her retirement following North Melbourne's third straight premiership victory alongside teammate and partner Kate Shierlaw.

items.title: What to expect with Victoria's election count tonight
items.summary: For months, the politics and polls of this Victorian state election have been signalling that the result may be one of the most complex in Australian political history.

items.title: MotoGP circuit to claim fewer trees as transplant solution offered
items.summary: The state government says it will "save" 94 olive trees originally destined for removal to make way for the MotoGP circuit design.

items.title: Culture preserved in new Aboriginal language dictionaries
items.summary: Linguists worked with current-day speakers to safeguard two Aboriginal languages in WA's Pilbara. Traditional owners say they can be an important resource for the next generation.

items.title: Workers who lose their jobs to AI say they're also addicted to using it
items.summary: AI has transformed China's entertainment industry, and even those who have lost their jobs to it still find themselves captured by its allure.

items.title: Alleged machete attack on NT woman by partner prompts police search
items.summary: Police are searching for a man who allegedly attacked his 22-year-old female partner with a machete, resulting in her receiving "serious injuries" to her left arm.

items.title: Deaths double for endangered Queensland bird as AI solution stalls
items.summary: Cassowary advocates in Far North Queensland are questioning why a successful AI road sign trial hasn't been rolled out, as road deaths of the endangered bird almost double this year.

items.title: Ballot bungle: What a 10-second photo op at Kensington Primary revealed about Ellen Sandell’s vote
items.summary: A photo of her ballot confirmed the Greens leader voted differently to what she advised her own constituents to do.

items.title: Victorian election 2026 LIVE updates: Polls point to Coalition victory despite anger over late policy release; Liberal HQ bars reporter from post-election party
items.summary: With the Coalition in the box seat to form government, Labor has shifted its focus to holding off One Nation in its heartland seats.

items.title: Polls will soon close in Victoria
items.summary: Last minute polls show Jess Wilson is set to become Victorian Premier as final Victorians vote.

items.title: Baby on driver’s lap one of thousands seen from new Mitchell Freeway AI cameras
items.summary: In the space of five months, more than 34,000 drivers were caught using their mobile phones and not wearing seatbelts correctly on the Perth road.

items.title: Chaz Mostert's crash finishes his championship hopes
items.summary: On the opening lap of the penultimate Supercars race of 2026, Chaz Mostert was involved in a huge crash that took out camera cables in Adelaide.

items.title: Apartment in former inner-north theatre sells for $1.2m at auction
items.summary: A young Geelong buyer will move back to Melbourne after snapping up the historic two-bedder. It went for $205,000 above the reserve at the hotly contested auction.

items.title: Police investigate allegations a school camp staffer inappropriately touched students
items.summary: Officers plan to speak to children at a school in north-west NSW on Monday as part of their inquiries.

items.title: ‘Waiting to see rock bottom’: Art deco north shore home passes in for $3.2m
items.summary: The agent was anticipating strong bidding, but only two parties showed up, and they could not be enticed to participate. The property passed in after 10 minutes.

items.title: Victorian hot seats: Why John Pesutto is betting ‘double or nothing’ on Hawthorn
items.summary: For much of the election, the mood has been one of a need for change. But on Saturday morning, voter frustration about the Coalition’s eleventh-hour announcements was palpable.
